name: Metal Gear Solid: Digital Graphic Novel
source:
Metal Gear Solid: Digital Graphic Novel (known in Japan as Metal Gear Solid: Bande Dessinée; French for "comic strip") is an interactive comic book developed by Kojima Productions and published by Konami for the PlayStation Portable.

The story is based on the Metal Gear Solid comic which was written by Kris Oprisko and illustrated by Ashley Wood.

[Edited from [url=https://metalgear.fandom.com/wiki/Metal_Gear_Solid:_Digital_Graphic_Novel]Metal Gear Wiki[/url]]
